map.净持有成本率 = r + u − q（r 无风险利率，u 存储成本率，q 便利收: Net cost-of-carry rate = r + u − q (r = risk-free rate, u = storage cost rate, q = convenience yield)
map.连续复利模式：F = S × e^[(r+u−q) × T]: Continuous compounding: F = S × e^[(r+u−q) × T]
map.持有成本 = F − S；持有成本率 = (F − S) ÷ S × 100%: Cost of carry = F − S; cost-of-carry rate = (F − S) ÷ S × 100%
map.基差 = S − F；F ≥ S 为正向市场，F < S 为反向市场: Basis = S − F; F ≥ S is a contango market, F < S is backwardation
map.套利分析：实际价 < 理论价 → 买期货卖现货（正向套利）: Arbitrage analysis: actual price < theoretical price → buy futures, sell spot (cash-and-carry arbitrage)
map.实际价 > 理论价 → 卖期货买现货（反向套利）: Actual price > theoretical price → sell futures, buy spot (reverse cash-and-carry arbitrage)
map.Deviation = 实际价 − 理论价；偏差率 = 偏差 ÷ 理论价 × 1: Deviation = actual price − theoretical price; deviation rate = deviation ÷ theoretical price × 100%
map.约束：现货价与到期时间须 > 0: Constraint: spot price and time to maturity must be > 0
map.其中：S=现货价格，r=无风险利率，u=存储成本率，q=便利收益率/股息率，T=: Where: S = spot price, r = risk-free rate, u = storage cost rate, q = convenience/dividend yield, T = time to maturity
map.= F - S（持有现货到期的成本）: = F − S (cost of holding the spot until maturity)
map.：期货价格 > 现货价格（持有成本为正）: : futures price > spot price (positive cost of carry)
map.：期货价格 < 现货价格（便利收益高）: : futures price < spot price (high convenience yield)
map.：实际价格偏离理论价格时存在套利机会: : arbitrage opportunities arise when the actual price deviates from the theoretical price
map.：临近到期，期货价格趋近现货价格: : as maturity approaches, the futures price converges to the spot price
map.本模型适用于金融期货与可存储商品期货。不可存储商品（如电力、生鲜）不适用此模型。: This model applies to financial futures and storable commodity futures. Non-storable commodities such as electricity and fresh produce do not fit this model.
map.📚 深度解析：期货理论价（持有成本模型）: 📚 Deep Dive: Theoretical Futures Price (Cost-of-Carry Model)
map.持有成本模型：理论价 F = S×(1 + (r + u − q)×T)（单利）: Cost-of-carry model: theoretical price F = S×(1 + (r + u − q)×T) (simple) or S·e^((r+u−q)T) (continuous), where S is spot, r the rate, u the storage rate, q the dividend/convenience yield, and T years to maturity; F−S is the cost of carry and S−F is the basis.
map.现货 5000、r=4%、u=0.5%、q=1%、T=0.25 年 → 净持有成: Spot 5000, r=4%, u=0.5%, q=1%, T=0.25 year → net cost-of-carry rate 3.5%, F=5000×(1+3.5%×0.25)=5043.75 (continuous compounding 5043.94); cost of carry 43.75, basis −43.75, and F>spot means “contango.” For pricing reference only; not investment advice.
map.基差负说明什么？: What does a negative basis mean?
map.正向市场中期货高于现货、基差为负属正常；基差走阔/收窄反映持有成本与预期变化，用: In contango, futures above spot and a negative basis are normal; a widening or narrowing basis reflects changes in the cost of carry and expectations, and is used for arbitrage and hedging decisions.
map.结果能当成交价吗？: Can the result be used as a transaction price?
map.不能，理论价仅模型估算，实际受流动性、交割、情绪影响；本工具为纯计算演示、不获取: No. The theoretical price is only a model estimate; actual prices are affected by liquidity, delivery, and sentiment. This tool is a pure calculation demo and does not fetch live quotes.
map.偏差 = 实际价 − 理论价；偏差率 = 偏差 ÷ 理论价 × 100%: Deviation = actual price − theoretical price; deviation rate = deviation ÷ theoretical price × 100%
map.持有成本模型：理论价 F = S×(1+(r+u−q)×T)（单利）或 S·e^: Cost-of-carry model: theoretical F = S×(1+(r+u−q)×T) (simple) or S·e^((r+u−q)T) (continuous). The spread is actual minus theoretical: above theoretical suggests selling futures and buying spot, below suggests buying futures and selling spot. The spread is only a model hint and excludes fees, impact cost, financing, delivery limits and basis risk.
map.现货 5000、r=4%、u=0.5%、q=1%、T=0.25 → F=5043: Spot 5000, r=4%, u=0.5%, q=1%, T=0.25 gives F=5043.94. An actual price of 5100 gives a spread of +56.06 and shows “actual above theoretical, consider selling futures and buying spot”; an actual price of 5000 gives −43.94 with the opposite direction. An absolute spread below 0.005 is treated as equal.
map.不能。理论价仅模型估算，实际受流动性、交割、情绪影响；价差未计交易成本与交割限制: No. The theoretical price is a model estimate; actual prices are affected by liquidity, delivery and sentiment. The spread excludes trading costs and delivery limits, so it is not a conclusion that arbitrage is feasible.
